Sophie (Presales): Heads-up: POC tomorrow with BigBox Grocery. Req: low-latency streaming chat for cashiers, server-side tool `price_check` that hits their pricing DB, and nightly CSV output for ETL. Also need webhook fallback and SSO for their engineers. Can we confirm SDK recipes + any blockers?
Oliver (DevEx): Nice. Quick clarifications: do they want bidirectional streaming (cashier sends, server sends tool prompts) or just server->client updates? Also: CSV vs JSON line protocol for ETL?
Sophie (Presales): Bidirectional. Cashier UI should get immediate price validation when barcode scanned and we may call external price service (~200-800ms typical, occasionally 3-6s). ETL team wants newline-delimited CSV rows: sku,price,store,timestamp.
Kai (Solutions): For bidirectional use WebSocket. SSE won't handle client->server tool call events well. Our Go/JS/PDK clients support socket streams. Caveat: Go SDK had a reconnect bug pre-1.9.0 — require >=1.9.0.
Oliver (DevEx): Example Go pattern we give for streaming + tool events:
```go
stream, err := client.ChatStream(ctx, opts)
for stream.Next() {
  ev := stream.Event()
  switch ev.Type {
  case EventMessage:
    fmt.Println(ev.Text)
  case EventToolCall:
    // run price_check and send tool response
    resp := runPriceCheck(ev.Payload)
    stream.SendToolResult(resp)
  }
}
```
Note: SendToolResult blocks until ack or timeout.
Priya (Security): Webhook fallback must be signed (HMAC-SHA256) + timestamp + nonce. For SSO we support SAML 2.0 and OIDC; they prefer SAML. We can do SCIM for user sync. Secrets: recommend short-lived webhook tokens for Dedicated; hosted can use rotation API.
Diego (SRE): Load notes: 200 req/s sustained with streaming + tool calls means many long-lived sockets. Recommend connection pinning to a region and stick sessions to a dedicated pool. Keep-alive and TCP tuning matter (idle timeouts). We'll provide a perf checklist.
Ana (AE): Pricing delta: rough rule: at this scale Dedicated reserved pool recommended. I'll send a thumb rule: Dedicated base + throughput add-on ~2.5x hosted per-token cost for streaming-heavy workloads. Will confirm numbers.
Sophie (Presales): Tool timeout? External price service can take 3-6s occasionally. What's default?
Oliver (DevEx): Default tool timeout = 8s. You can configure per-route up to 30s. For longer ops suggest async flow: return partial placeholder in stream and post final via webhook. We also support patch events to update prior message with final result.
Priya (Security): Replay protection: reject signatures older than 5 minutes. Log webhook delivery attempts. If using SAML, we'll need metadata xml and a test SP.
Diego (SRE): For CSV lines: avoid streaming huge bursts. Buffer and flush at steady rate or use batching credits. Also recommend sequence_id and checksum on each CSV row to detect missing rows.
Oliver (DevEx): CSV generation tip: emit JSON-LD intermediate then transform to CSV on ingestion to avoid type coercion issues (numbers vs strings). Add schema header first row.
Sophie (Presales): Any SDK helpers for CSV/line protocol or Java client examples? Client infra is Kotlin-based.
Oliver (DevEx): We have Kotlin examples in the repo; not a separate CSV helper — simple fmt builder is fine. I'll attach sample Kotlin snippet for HMAC and streaming in the pack.
Kai (Solutions): Known blockers: if they insist on client IP allowlist + hosted, webhook delivery may fail when senders rotate IPs. Recommend Private deployment or mTLS. Also note GPU quantization may affect latency for certain model sizes.
Priya (Security): For audit: we can provide audit logs for tool calls and webhook deliveries in Dedicated/Private. Hosted has 30-day retention for presales packs.
Ana (AE): Action items for presales pack: perf runbook, Go/Kotlin snippets, webhook HMAC sample, SAML metadata checklist, rough Dedicated pricing delta. Who owns?
Oliver (DevEx): I'll own snippets + runbook. ETA 3 hours.
Diego (SRE): I'll produce perf checklist and connection tuning notes.
Priya (Security): I'll draft security questionnaire answers (SAML flows, webhook signing, token rotation).
Ana (AE): I'll prepare price ballpark and sales slide.
